title: Great App for Tracking Bonsai Care
text: I've been extremely pleased with this bonsai care app. It has made caring for my bonsai trees much easier and more enjoyable. The reminders for watering, pruning, and fertilizing help me stay on track, and the care information is clear, practical, and easy to follow. I especially appreciate how the app provides guidance tailored to different bonsai species, which has helped my trees stay healthy and thrive. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced bonsai enthusiast, this app is an excellent resource. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to give their bonsai the best possible care!

title: Bonsai People Need This App
text:
I have been exploring Bonsai for the last few years and found this app to help me keep track of my trees. I love it. Simple to use. Customer Service is excellent. Yesterday (Sunday) I was logged  out and was not getting the code sent to my email. I sent an email and it was responded ti with in a few hours. We figured out the code was going to my junk mail, so I added to my contacts, problem solved. 

If you have a few trees, or a lot of trees, you need this app. It also has great info about the trees. All in one app. 

Just buy it, you will not regret it.

I tried entering the info into various Tree Info  fields but only the name and species and custom species seem to be included in the search.

2. A field for a link to more info would be great, esp for species that are not already in the catalog, so I could link over to the site I used for info. If I put it in the Notes field it is visible on the tree info page which is great, but not clickable or even copiable.

Thanks!

text:
I really love this app a whole lot! There are a few ideas I’d recommend.
 1st being able to search your trees so you don’t have to scroll to find them.
 2nd being able to put trees into the indoor/outdoor category during specific times of the year.
3rd setting your own personal reminders other than just the water,fertilize, pests, etc.
4th minor bug fixes when every time you click on a reminder check mark it resets the screen and resets you at the top instead of being able to click multiples of them before it resets you at the top. 
5th you guys are doing a great job! You made a bonsai app that is super available and affordable for the masses. I recommend this app to everyone who practices bonsai! I look forward to seeing this app grow!

title: Not impressed
text:
I am a Bonsai Empire fan, I have purchased many of their online courses, and think their work, knowledge and ability to teach are great. 

The app is functional, though 30 years playing with trees and 80 trees in the back yard I hardly need to be reminded of when to water and fertilize. The seasonal image library was a great idea, but when I hit tree 6, it looks for an upgrade, not a one off purchase, but dipping into my wallet over and over again. 

If you are a beginner or received a gift Bonsai, you will love it, if you are a serious grower, I cannot see the value.

title: Great with room for improvement
text:
This is a VERY helpful app. The minute you open it, it all just makes sense and is super easy to use. Big fan of everything Bonsai Empire do.

My only disappointment is that it only has one Australian native. I have two Coastal Tea Trees and a Banksia and there’s no info for either. For custom trees, it’d be useful to be able to change the Care Guide.

I’d really like the reminders to stay with a little „overdue since X days“ badge. At the moment for me the reminders are barely useful in this way unfortunately.

Keep up the great work! I otherwise love the app!
